answer: Payout follows the rubric an answer leaves behind. The ledger distills each submission into a rubric, handed at random to jurors grading unrelated answers; a control group grades blind. An author earns only when armed jurors land closer to consensus than the blind group. Watch for a signal at dawn is no test; grading how cedar grain separates a real signal from wind noise is. A farm copying one shell ships identical useless rubrics, so the same failure recurs and earns nothing. Honest authors state criteria they already used. Attacker cost: N rubrics that improve strangers' grades.
